```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(httr2)
library(jsonlite)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(readr)
```


```{r load-data}
# Load dataset from notebook 01
drug_data <- readRDS("data/final_dataset.rds")

cat("Dataset loaded successfully\n")
cat("Rows:", nrow(drug_data), "\n")
cat("Columns:", ncol(drug_data), "\n")
cat("Columns available:", paste(names(drug_data), collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

```{r experimental-pka, message=TRUE}

# Drop pKa columns if they already exist (allows safe rerunning)
drug_data <- drug_data |>
  dplyr::select(-dplyr::any_of(c("pKa_exp", "N_pka", "pKa_values")))
pka_results <- data.frame()

for (i in 1:nrow(drug_data)) {
  drug <- drug_data$Drug[i]
  chembl_id <- drug_data$ChEMBL_ID[i]
  
  tryCatch({
    url <- paste0("https://www.ebi.ac.uk/chembl/api/data/activity.json?molecule_chembl_id=",
                  chembl_id, "&standard_type=pKa&limit=100")
    
    req <- httr2::request(url) |> httr2::req_headers(Accept = "application/json")
    response <- httr2::req_perform(req)
    parsed <- jsonlite::fromJSON(httr2::resp_body_string(response), flatten = TRUE)
    activities <- parsed$activities
    
    if (is.null(activities) || !is.data.frame(activities) || nrow(activities) == 0) {
      pka_results <- dplyr::bind_rows(pka_results,
        data.frame(ChEMBL_ID = chembl_id,
                   pKa_exp = NA,
                   N_pka = 0,
                   pKa_values = NA))
    } else {
      filtered <- activities |>
        dplyr::filter(!is.na(standard_value)) |>
        dplyr::mutate(standard_value = as.numeric(standard_value)) |>
        dplyr::filter(standard_value >= 0, standard_value <= 14)
      
      if (nrow(filtered) == 0) {
        pka_results <- dplyr::bind_rows(pka_results,
          data.frame(ChEMBL_ID = chembl_id,
                     pKa_exp = NA,
                     N_pka = 0,
                     pKa_values = NA))
      } else {
        pka_results <- dplyr::bind_rows(pka_results,
          data.frame(ChEMBL_ID = chembl_id,
                     pKa_exp = median(filtered$standard_value, na.rm = TRUE),
                     N_pka = nrow(filtered),
                     pKa_values = paste(filtered$standard_value, collapse = ", ")))
      }
    }
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    message(paste("Error for", drug, ":", e$message))
    pka_results <<- dplyr::bind_rows(pka_results,
      data.frame(ChEMBL_ID = chembl_id,
                 pKa_exp = NA,
                 N_pka = 0,
                 pKa_values = NA))
  })
}

# Join with drug_data
drug_data <- drug_data |>
  dplyr::left_join(pka_results, by = "ChEMBL_ID")

cat("pKa SUMMARY\n")
cat("Drugs with experimental pKa:", sum(!is.na(drug_data$pKa_exp)), "\n")
cat("Drugs missing pKa:", sum(is.na(drug_data$pKa_exp)), "\n")
```

```{r experimental-logd, message=TRUE}

# Drop LogD columns if they already exist (allows safe rerunning)
drug_data <- drug_data |>
  dplyr::select(-dplyr::any_of(c("LogD74_exp", "N_logd", "LogD_values")))
logd_results <- data.frame()

for (i in 1:nrow(drug_data)) {
  drug <- drug_data$Drug[i]
  chembl_id <- drug_data$ChEMBL_ID[i]
  
  tryCatch({
    url <- paste0("https://www.ebi.ac.uk/chembl/api/data/activity.json?molecule_chembl_id=",
                  chembl_id, "&standard_type=LogD&limit=100")
    
    req <- httr2::request(url) |> httr2::req_headers(Accept = "application/json")
    response <- httr2::req_perform(req)
    parsed <- jsonlite::fromJSON(httr2::resp_body_string(response), flatten = TRUE)
    activities <- parsed$activities
    
    if (is.null(activities) || !is.data.frame(activities) || nrow(activities) == 0) {
      logd_results <- dplyr::bind_rows(logd_results,
        data.frame(ChEMBL_ID = chembl_id,
                   LogD74_exp = NA,
                   N_logd = 0,
                   LogD_values = NA))
    } else {
      # Filter for pH 7.4 specifically
      filtered <- activities |>
        dplyr::filter(
          !is.na(standard_value),
          stringr::str_detect(tolower(assay_description), "7\\.4|7\\.40|physiolog")
        ) |>
        dplyr::mutate(standard_value = as.numeric(standard_value))
      
      if (nrow(filtered) == 0) {
        logd_results <- dplyr::bind_rows(logd_results,
          data.frame(ChEMBL_ID = chembl_id,
                     LogD74_exp = NA,
                     N_logd = 0,
                     LogD_values = NA))
      } else {
        logd_results <- dplyr::bind_rows(logd_results,
          data.frame(ChEMBL_ID = chembl_id,
                     LogD74_exp = median(filtered$standard_value, na.rm = TRUE),
                     N_logd = nrow(filtered),
                     LogD_values = paste(filtered$standard_value, collapse = ", ")))
      }
    }
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    message(paste("Error for", drug, ":", e$message))
    logd_results <<- dplyr::bind_rows(logd_results,
      data.frame(ChEMBL_ID = chembl_id,
                 LogD74_exp = NA,
                 N_logd = 0,
                 LogD_values = NA))
  })
}

# Join with drug_data
drug_data <- drug_data |>
  dplyr::left_join(logd_results, by = "ChEMBL_ID")

cat("LogD7.4 SUMMARY\n")
cat("Drugs with experimental LogD7.4:", sum(!is.na(drug_data$LogD74_exp)), "\n")
cat("Drugs missing LogD7.4:", sum(is.na(drug_data$LogD74_exp)), "\n")
```

```{r merge-opera}
# Clean up OPERA data
opera_clean <- opera |>
  dplyr::select(
    INPUT,
    pKa_acid_pred = OPERA_PKAA_OPERA_PRED,
    pKa_base_pred = OPERA_PKAB_OPERA_PRED,
    LogD74_pred = LOGD7.4
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    pKa_acid_pred = dplyr::na_if(pKa_acid_pred, "N/A"),
    pKa_base_pred = dplyr::na_if(pKa_base_pred, "N/A"),
    LogD74_pred = dplyr::na_if(LogD74_pred, "N/A"),
    pKa_acid_pred = as.numeric(pKa_acid_pred),
    pKa_base_pred = as.numeric(pKa_base_pred),
    LogD74_pred = as.numeric(LogD74_pred)
  ) |>
  dplyr::distinct(INPUT, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Merge with drug_data by drug name
drug_data <- drug_data |>
  dplyr::left_join(opera_clean, by = c("Drug" = "INPUT"))

cat("OPERA MERGE SUMMARY\n")
cat("Rows after merge:", nrow(drug_data), "\n")
cat("Drugs with predicted pKa acid:", sum(!is.na(drug_data$pKa_acid_pred)), "\n")
cat("Drugs with predicted pKa base:", sum(!is.na(drug_data$pKa_base_pred)), "\n")
cat("Drugs with predicted LogD7.4:", sum(!is.na(drug_data$LogD74_pred)), "\n")
```

```{r compare-logp-pka}
# Load OPERA data
opera <- readr::read_csv("data/OPERA.csv") |>
  dplyr::select(
    INPUT,
    LogP_opera = OCTANOL_WATER_PARTITION_LOGP_OPERA_PRED
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    LogP_opera = dplyr::na_if(LogP_opera, "N/A"),
    LogP_opera = as.numeric(LogP_opera)
  ) |>
  dplyr::distinct(INPUT, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Merge OPERA LogP into drug_data
drug_data <- drug_data |>
  dplyr::left_join(opera, by = c("Drug" = "INPUT"))

# Calculate differences
drug_data <- drug_data |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    LogP_chembl = as.numeric(LogP),
    LogP_diff = abs(LogP_chembl - LogP_opera),
    pKa_diff = abs(pKa_exp - pKa_acid_pred)
  )

cat("LogP COMPARISON (ChEMBL alogP vs OPERA)\n")
cat("Drugs with both values:", sum(!is.na(drug_data$LogP_chembl) & !is.na(drug_data$LogP_opera)), "\n")
cat("Mean absolute difference:", round(mean(drug_data$LogP_diff, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
cat("Max difference:", round(max(drug_data$LogP_diff, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
cat("Drugs with difference > 1:", sum(drug_data$LogP_diff > 1, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

cat("\npKa COMPARISON (ChEMBL experimental vs OPERA predicted)\n")
cat("Drugs with both values:", sum(!is.na(drug_data$pKa_exp) & !is.na(drug_data$pKa_acid_pred)), "\n")
cat("Mean absolute difference:", round(mean(drug_data$pKa_diff, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
cat("Max difference:", round(max(drug_data$pKa_diff, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
cat("Drugs with difference > 1:", sum(drug_data$pKa_diff > 1, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

cat("\nDRUGS WITH LARGE LogP DIFFERENCE (>1)\n")
drug_data |>
  dplyr::filter(LogP_diff > 1) |>
  dplyr::select(Drug, LogP_chembl, LogP_opera, LogP_diff) |>
  dplyr::arrange(desc(LogP_diff)) |>
  print()

cat("\n DRUGS WITH LARGE pKa DIFFERENCE (>2)\n")
drug_data |>
  dplyr::filter(pKa_diff > 2) |>
  dplyr::select(Drug, pKa_exp, pKa_acid_pred, pKa_diff) |>
  dplyr::arrange(desc(pKa_diff)) |>
  print()
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

drug_data <- readRDS("data/drug_data_complete.rds")

pH <- 7.4

# Function to calculate LogD using Henderson-Hasselbalch
calc_logd <- function(logp, pka, type) {
  case_when(
    type == "ACID" ~ logp - log10(1 + 10^(pH - pka)),
    type == "BASE" ~ logp - log10(1 + 10^(pka - pH)),
    type == "AMPHOLYTE" ~ NA_real_,  # needs both pKa values - handle separately
    type == "NEUTRAL" ~ logp,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  )
}

# LogD calculated using ChEMBL LogP + ChEMBL experimental pKa
drug_data <- drug_data |>
  mutate(
    LogD74_calc_exp = case_when(
      Type == "ACID" ~ LogP_chembl - log10(1 + 10^(pH - pKa_exp)),
      Type == "BASE" ~ LogP_chembl - log10(1 + 10^(pKa_exp - pH)),
      Type == "NEUTRAL" ~ LogP_chembl,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

# LogD calculated using ChEMBL LogP + OPERA predicted pKa (acid or base)
drug_data <- drug_data |>
  mutate(
    pKa_opera_relevant = case_when(
      Type == "ACID" ~ pKa_acid_pred,
      Type == "BASE" ~ pKa_base_pred,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    LogD74_calc_opera = case_when(
      Type == "ACID" ~ LogP_chembl - log10(1 + 10^(pH - pKa_acid_pred)),
      Type == "BASE" ~ LogP_chembl - log10(1 + 10^(pKa_acid_pred - pH)),
      Type == "NEUTRAL" ~ LogP_chembl,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

# Fix BASE case - should use pKa_base_pred not pKa_acid_pred
drug_data <- drug_data |>
  mutate(
    LogD74_calc_opera = case_when(
      Type == "ACID" ~ LogP_chembl - log10(1 + 10^(pH - pKa_acid_pred)),
      Type == "BASE" ~ LogP_chembl - log10(1 + 10^(pKa_base_pred - pH)),
      Type == "NEUTRAL" ~ LogP_chembl,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

cat("LogD CALCULATION SUMMARY\n")
cat("LogD74_calc_exp available:", sum(!is.na(drug_data$LogD74_calc_exp)), "/", nrow(drug_data), "\n")
cat("LogD74_calc_opera available:", sum(!is.na(drug_data$LogD74_calc_opera)), "/", nrow(drug_data), "\n")

# Save
saveRDS(drug_data, "data/drug_data_complete.rds")
readr::write_csv(drug_data, "data/drug_data_complete.csv")
cat("\nSaved with", ncol(drug_data), "columns\n")
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)

drug_data <- readRDS("data/drug_data_complete.rds")

# Reshape to long format for combined plotting
plot_data <- drug_data |>
  filter(!is.na(LogD74_exp)) |>
  select(Drug, LogD74_exp, LogD74_pred, LogD74_calc_exp, LogD74_calc_opera) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c(LogD74_pred, LogD74_calc_exp, LogD74_calc_opera),
               names_to = "Source", values_to = "Value") |>
  filter(!is.na(Value)) |>
  mutate(Source = recode(Source,
    LogD74_pred = "OPERA Predicted",
    LogD74_calc_exp = "Calculated (ChEMBL pKa)",
    LogD74_calc_opera = "Calculated (OPERA pKa)"
  ))

p_combined <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = LogD74_exp, y = Value, color = Source)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  labs(title = "Experimental LogD7.4 vs Three Alternative Sources",
       x = "Experimental LogD7.4 (ChEMBL)",
       y = "Alternative LogD7.4 Value",
       color = "Source") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("OPERA Predicted" = "steelblue",
                                 "Calculated (ChEMBL pKa)" = "darkgreen",
                                 "Calculated (OPERA pKa)" = "darkorange"))

print(p_combined)
```

``` {r}
summary_table <- data.frame(
  Source = c("OPERA Predicted", "Calculated (ChEMBL pKa)", "Calculated (OPERA pKa)"),
  N = c(
    sum(!is.na(drug_data$LogD74_exp) & !is.na(drug_data$LogD74_pred)),
    sum(!is.na(drug_data$LogD74_exp) & !is.na(drug_data$LogD74_calc_exp)),
    sum(!is.na(drug_data$LogD74_exp) & !is.na(drug_data$LogD74_calc_opera))
  ),
  Mean_Abs_Diff = c(
    mean(abs(drug_data$LogD74_exp - drug_data$LogD74_pred), na.rm = TRUE),
    mean(abs(drug_data$LogD74_exp - drug_data$LogD74_calc_exp), na.rm = TRUE),
    mean(abs(drug_data$LogD74_exp - drug_data$LogD74_calc_opera), na.rm = TRUE)
  ),
  RMSE = c(
    sqrt(mean((drug_data$LogD74_exp - drug_data$LogD74_pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
    sqrt(mean((drug_data$LogD74_exp - drug_data$LogD74_calc_exp)^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
    sqrt(mean((drug_data$LogD74_exp - drug_data$LogD74_calc_opera)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
  ),
  Max_Diff = c(
    max(abs(drug_data$LogD74_exp - drug_data$LogD74_pred), na.rm = TRUE),
    max(abs(drug_data$LogD74_exp - drug_data$LogD74_calc_exp), na.rm = TRUE),
    max(abs(drug_data$LogD74_exp - drug_data$LogD74_calc_opera), na.rm = TRUE)
  ),
  Correlation = c(
    cor(drug_data$LogD74_exp, drug_data$LogD74_pred, use = "complete.obs"),
    cor(drug_data$LogD74_exp, drug_data$LogD74_calc_exp, use = "complete.obs"),
    cor(drug_data$LogD74_exp, drug_data$LogD74_calc_opera, use = "complete.obs")
  )
) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 3)))

print(summary_table)
```

``` {r}
library(reticulate)
use_condaenv("pka_prediction", required = TRUE)

rdkit_chem <- import("rdkit.Chem")
pkasolver_query <- import("pkasolver.query")

drug_data <- readRDS("data/drug_data_complete.rds")

get_pka_details <- function(smiles) {
  tryCatch({
    mol <- rdkit_chem$MolFromSmiles(smiles)
    if (is.null(mol)) return(list(pka = NA, type = NA, n = 0))
    
    states <- pkasolver_query$calculate_microstate_pka_values(mol, only_dimorphite = FALSE)
    
    pka_vals <- c()
    type_vals <- c()
    
    for (s in states) {
      prot_charge <- s$protonated_mol$GetAtomWithIdx(as.integer(s$reaction_center_idx))$GetFormalCharge()
      deprot_charge <- s$deprotonated_mol$GetAtomWithIdx(as.integer(s$reaction_center_idx))$GetFormalCharge()
      
      site_type <- if (prot_charge > deprot_charge && deprot_charge == 0) {
        "BASE"
      } else if (prot_charge == 0 && deprot_charge < 0) {
        "ACID"
      } else {
        "OTHER"
      }
      
      pka_vals <- c(pka_vals, round(s$pka, 3))
      type_vals <- c(type_vals, site_type)
    }
    
    list(
      pka = paste(pka_vals, collapse = ", "),
      type = paste(type_vals, collapse = ", "),
      n = length(pka_vals)
    )
  }, error = function(e) list(pka = NA, type = NA, n = 0))
}

results <- lapply(drug_data$SMILES, get_pka_details)

drug_data$Type_pkasolver <- sapply(results, function(x) x$type)


cat("Drugs with pkasolver acid/base classification:", 
    sum(!is.na(drug_data$Type_pkasolver)), "/", nrow(drug_data), "\n")
```

``` {r}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(stringr)

drug_data <- readRDS("data/drug_data_complete.rds")

pH <- 7.4

calc_logd_pkasolver <- function(logp, pka_str, type_str) {
  if (is.na(logp) || is.na(pka_str) || is.na(type_str)) return(NA_real_)
  
  pkas <- as.numeric(str_split(pka_str, ", ")[[1]])
  types <- str_split(type_str, ", ")[[1]]
  
  # Filter out pKas more than 4 units from pH 7.4
  keep <- abs(pkas - pH) <= 4
  pkas <- pkas[keep]
  types <- types[keep]
  
  if (length(pkas) == 0) return(logp)  # nothing relevant -> treat as neutral
  
  acid_pkas <- sort(pkas[types == "ACID"])
  base_pkas <- sort(pkas[types == "BASE"], decreasing = TRUE)
  
  # fraction neutral for acid side 
  if (length(acid_pkas) == 0) {
    f_acid <- 1
  } else if (length(acid_pkas) == 1) {
    f_acid <- 1 / (1 + 10^(pH - acid_pkas[1]))
  } else {
    pka1 <- acid_pkas[1]
    pka2 <- acid_pkas[2]
    f_acid <- 1 / (1 + 10^(pH - pka1) + 10^(2*pH - pka1 - pka2))
  }
  
  # fraction neutral for base side 
  if (length(base_pkas) == 0) {
    f_base <- 1
  } else if (length(base_pkas) == 1) {
    f_base <- 1 / (1 + 10^(base_pkas[1] - pH))
  } else {
    pka1 <- base_pkas[1]
    pka2 <- base_pkas[2]
    f_base <- 1 / (1 + 10^(pka1 - pH) + 10^(pka1 + pka2 - 2*pH))
  }
  
  f_neutral <- f_acid * f_base
  
  logd <- logp + log10(f_neutral)
  return(logd)
}

drug_data <- drug_data |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    LogD74_calc_pkasolver = calc_logd_pkasolver(LogP_chembl, pKa_pkasolver, Type_pkasolver)
  ) |>
  ungroup()

cat("LogD from pkasolver pKa\n")
cat("Available:", sum(!is.na(drug_data$LogD74_calc_pkasolver)), "/", nrow(drug_data), "\n")

saveRDS(drug_data, "data/drug_data_complete.rds")
write_csv(drug_data, "data/drug_data_complete.csv")
```

``` {r}
library(ggplot2)

drug_data <- readRDS("data/drug_data_complete.rds")

compare_data <- drug_data |>
  filter(!is.na(LogD74_calc_opera), !is.na(LogD74_calc_pkasolver))

cat("Drugs with both OPERA-derived and pkasolver-derived LogD:", nrow(compare_data), "\n")

# Fit linear regression
model <- lm(LogD74_calc_pkasolver ~ LogD74_calc_opera, data = compare_data)
r_squared <- summary(model)$r.squared
cat("R-squared:", round(r_squared, 3), "\n")

p <- ggplot(compare_data, aes(x = LogD74_calc_opera, y = LogD74_calc_pkasolver)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, color = "purple") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "blue") +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  labs(title = "LogD7.4 Calculated: OPERA pKa vs pkasolver pKa",
       subtitle = paste0("R² = ", round(r_squared, 3), " (blue = fitted regression, red = y=x)"),
       x = "LogD7.4 (calculated using OPERA pKa)",
       y = "LogD7.4 (calculated using pkasolver pKa)") +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave("data/plot_logd_opera_vs_pkasolver.png", p, width = 7, height = 6)
print(p)
```

``` {r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

drug_data <- readRDS("data/drug_data_complete.rds")

get_relevant_pkasolver_pka <- function(pka_str, type_str, drug_type) {
  if (is.na(pka_str) || is.na(type_str)) return(NA_real_)
  
  pkas <- as.numeric(str_split(pka_str, ", ")[[1]])
  types <- str_split(type_str, ", ")[[1]]
  
  if (drug_type == "ACID") {
    acid_pkas <- pkas[types == "ACID"]
    if (length(acid_pkas) == 0) return(NA_real_)
    return(min(acid_pkas))  # lowest acidic pKa
  } else if (drug_type == "BASE") {
    base_pkas <- pkas[types == "BASE"]
    if (length(base_pkas) == 0) return(NA_real_)
    return(max(base_pkas))  # highest basic pKa
  } else {
    return(NA_real_)
  }
}

drug_data <- drug_data |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    pKa_pkasolver_relevant = get_relevant_pkasolver_pka(pKa_pkasolver, Type_pkasolver, Type)
  ) |>
  ungroup()

cat("Drugs with pKa_pkasolver_relevant:", sum(!is.na(drug_data$pKa_pkasolver_relevant)), "/", nrow(drug_data), "\n")

saveRDS(drug_data, "data/drug_data_complete.rds")
readr::write_csv(drug_data, "data/drug_data_complete.csv")
```
